site.name: IM-1 Odysseus landing point (Malapert A region)
site.coordinate_frame: MOON_ME body-fixed frame (the kernel's MOON_ME is an alias for MOON_ME_DE440_ME421, closely aligned with the DE421 mean Earth/polar axis frame), planetodetic coordinates on a 1737.4 km sphere (= planetocentric for a sphere), east-positive longitude. The kernel states the frame; it does not state the coordinate's source or accuracy.
site.coordinate_source_title: NAIF CLPS IM-1 frames kernel clps_to2im_im1_v02.tf (Version 2, 2025-08-22): IM1_LANDING_SITE at latitude -80.12759, longitude 1.44587 deg, MOON_ME
site.coordinate_source_product: clps_to2im_im1_v02.tf (NAIF PDS4 CLPS SPICE archive); cross-check: LROC featured image 1360 (2024-02-26) gives 80.13 S, 1.44 E
site.point_description: where Intuitive Machines' IM-1 Odysseus lander came to rest on 2024-02-22 (it landed tilted on a slope)
site.coordinate_accuracy_note: not stated by the kernel; LROC's two-decimal value agrees to its rounding (0.005 deg of latitude is about 150 m)
site.surface_elevation_reference: Height above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere, LDEM_80S_20M V2.0, bilinear at the kernel's point interpreted in ME. Rounded to 0.1 m. LDEM_75S_60M gives 2592.30 m. The point is about 4 km inside the 20 m product's edge. No local LOLA RDR shot consistency check performed. See data/terrain/im1-odysseus_site_elevation_report.json.
site.horizons_altitude_reference: Height above the Horizons reference body for the Moon: a 1737.4 km sphere (response header 'Center radii'), the same reference as LOLA heights.
site.altitude_conversion_note: horizons_site_altitude_km = (surface_elevation_m + observer_height_above_surface_m) / 1000 = (2593.5 m + 1 m) / 1000 = 2.5945 km. Both heights are relative to the 1737.4 km sphere, so no datum conversion is needed. Rounding: the bilinear LDEM_80S_20M surface is 2593.53 m; it was rounded to 0.1 m before forming the altitude, so the submitted point is 0.9716 m above the interpolated surface (nominal 1 m). The NAIF kernel lists an altitude of 2.583 km for its site point (10.5 m lower; its basis is not stated); it is not used. The generic terrain horizon and rendering use this same configured observer; no observer substitution is made.

catalog.location_label: Intuitive Machines IM-1 Odysseus lander, came to rest 2024-02-22 (tilted); point from the NAIF CLPS frames kernel

radial_convergence.note: Every radial segment halved at 36 azimuths on the same DEM; not absolute terrain accuracy; first sample remains 5 m.

LDEM_80S_20M -> LDEM_75S_60M.note: Bilinear heights 500 m inside source transition; difference retained without averaging or vertical adjustment

LDEM_75S_60M -> LDEM_64.note: Bilinear heights 500 m inside source transition; difference retained without averaging or vertical adjustment

limitations: Source coordinates/frames retain their documented assumptions.
Global LDEM_64 is coarse distant terrain only; grid spacing varies with latitude. No fine obstacles are resolved.
No independent absolute terrain accuracy established. Source overlap statistics are differences, not accuracy estimates.
